ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65:35 ratio of low-intensity (black/dark-grey) to high-intensity (white/off-white) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid low-intensity (black) region occupying the central peduncle and extending along the superior trailing edge margins. High-intensity (white) regions are localized to the distal halves of both lobes, featuring scattered low-intensity focal points near the superior edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped notch with a calculated interior angle of approximately 45 degrees relative to the lobe peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge boundary. A notable large irregular indentation (missing tissue) is located on the trailing edge of the left lobe, approximately 15% lateral to the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve fitted to the leading edges (bottom), tapering to acute, slightly concave trajectories at the extreme lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Group of 4-6 distinct circular dark pixel clusters on the distal white region of the right lobe; dense, textured clusters of high-contrast anomalies (barnacles) located on the distal-most tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple faint, unaligned diagonal and horizontal linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) crossing the high-intensity white regions on both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A significant irregular notch/defect on the trailing edge of the left lobe near the median notch; heavy barnacle colonization and associated scarring at the lateral tips of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinct 'Type 2' pigmentation pattern with a symmetrical dark central core contrasted against bright white outer 'wings' on the lobes.
